checks: Catalog models unique, thumbnails local
Verified account and ADM ACE required on every mutation
Editor limited to main routing bucket
Whitelist rejects unknown models and console actions
Request cooldown enforced
Finite position, island boundaries, rotation, scale and batch size validated before disk writes
Server assigns IDs and author, persists and broadcasts all placements
Stale revision cannot overwrite another ADM edit
Undo removes own latest batch and preserves other ADM applications
Reposition preserves object ID and replaces persisted transform
Disk failure cannot mutate or broadcast world
Resource restart reloads saved objects and revision
Delete persisted and previous save backed up
Corrupted file fails loudly without erasing placements
Cayo Perico accepts placements in its own bounds and preserves object tilt
Ocean gap between editable islands is rejected
Server decodes only model metadata and reuses encoded thumbnails for synchronization
Preview releases NUI focus and creates only temporary local object
Preview follows player translation while flying and remains grounded
Up/down arrows adjust height symmetrically
Repeated transform keeps stable scale without compounding
Missing ground blocks commit; Enter submits validated transform and clears preview
Selecting another object abandons the unsaved preview and applies requested scale
Cancel deletes preview without saving
Permission revocation clears active preview
Resource stop cleans temporary objects
Caps selects nearby saved object and preserves its original transform
Resumed object follows movement and saves under the same ID
Caps cannot start editing without administrator permission
Frame loop survives cancellation during Wait and can place another preview
All entity matrix axes and coordinates passed as native floats, including scale 1
Client accepts encoded catalogue and preserves its last version after malformed updates
Thumbnail JSON reaches the browser unchanged, including repeated panel opens
Captured tilt preserves three full-size orthogonal axes and grounds rotated bounds
